ranks.name: Harvester
requirements:
Complete 3 beginner quests + 2 Intermediate quests 
(+Traveller Requirements).
rewards: 3 Forever Babies (boar, wolf, lox, chicken, asksvin, deer, hare)

Access to Hobbit Farm/Kitchen 
("Turbo" Windmills/Spinning Wheels/Fermenters)

reward.bonus:
L10 Scythe; L10 Harpoon; 100 Birch Seeds; 10 Acorns; 3 Forever Babies (boar, wolf, lox, chicken, asksvin, deer, hare); Access to Hobbit Farm/Kitchen 
("Turbo" Windmills/Spinning Wheels/Fermenters)

ranks.name: Dweller
requirements:
Complete 3 intermediate quests + 2 challenging quests 
(+ Harvester requirements). 
5 Event Quests must be completed within quest totals.
rewards: Hobbit Home (includes 5 pickables - 1 rasp, 1 blue, 1 thistle, 1 smoke, 1 fiddlehead and 1 bee)

Previous Era Heroic Dweller Only - L43 Rag Tunic/Legs 
(Odin Max)

reward.bonus:
L42 Circlet (43 Armor) (Odin Max); L10 Mistwalker  (Guild Max); L20 Silver Shield (Guild Max); L16 Lox Cape (Guild Max); Hobbit Home (includes 5 pickables - 1 rasp, 1 blue, 1 thistle, 1 smoke, 1 fiddlehead and 1 bee); Previous Era Heroic Dweller Only - L43 Rag Tunic/Legs 
(Odin Max)

achievements.name: Previous & Current Heroic Dweller
requirements: Complete 21 Hobbit Quests (current era and previous era)

achievements.name: Thain of the Shire
rewards: L4 Staff of the Wild (Creator Max)

achievements.name: Master Burglar
requirements: Reach 50 sneak skill and find the 10 chests and Arkenestone in Erebor.

achievements.name: Ring Bearer
requirements: Complete Barad-Dur, Helms Deep and Isengard wearing any Circlet

achievements.name: Farmor Maggot Returns
requirements: Find 4 2 empty Farmor Maggot quest sites and complete the quest requirements again.

achievements.name: Second Breakfast
requirements: Find 4 2 empty Hobbit Comfort Huts and leave 5 stacks of crafted food in the designated chest.

achievements.name: Baskets from Bag End
requirements: Craft one of every feast (8 total) and leave them in the wild in their corresponding biome. Place a torch and a sign that says "Free Baskets from Bag End".

achievements.name: Weekly Gifter
requirements: Gift 1 stack of current high-tier food to any player once a week and receive 1 acorn in return.

achievements.name: Gandalf's Grand Fireworks
requirements: Put on a grand firework show. Throwing at least 5 of each 6 firework colors (blue, cyan, green purple, red and yellow) into a bonfire for any comfy event you did not create. (Ex. Another player's Jarl Sail)
rewards: L16 -> L18 Dweller Lox Cape (Odin Max)
Horn of Celebration crafted by Gandalf the White

achievements.name: One Cape to Rule Them All
requirements: Collect and turn-in the 5 horn of celebrations crafted by 5 different LOTR characters. These can be found in the Dweller achievement rewards and Hobbit Creator Events.
rewards:
L24 Yellow Linen Cape (Odin Max) 
with the tag: "One Cape to Rule Them All"

achievements.name: Middle Earth Entertainer
requirements: Perform at 2 Hobbit Socials. Player must submit link to event post providing documentation (guild staff will not track repeats).

village_achievements.name: From Under the Hill
requirements: Create a Dweller Village by requesting to place your Hobbit Home with another Hobbit Home and have at least 3 Dwellers total living in the village (on the wards) to earn these rewards
rewards: Medieval-Styled Maxed Out Workshop - includes maxed workbench, forge, black forge, galdr table, 3 stonecutter supplies, 1 smelter, 1 blast furnace
Official Shire-Themed Village Name & Private Thread

village_achievements.name: There and Back Again
requirements: Create a Dweller Village by requesting to place your Hobbit Home with another Hobbit Home and have at least 5 Dwellers total living in the village (on the wards) to earn these rewards
rewards: Gated Oak Tree Portal to Exclusive Hobbit Hub Village Portal including 2 thistle

village_achievements.name: Hobbit Hospitality
requirements: Request for a Hobbit Social to be hosted at your Dweller Village and provide Hobbit Chef for the event. Make sure there is seating to accommodate 15 players.
